verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְקָֽרָאתָ֩ בְאָזְנֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה זָכַ֤רְתִּי לָךְ֙ חֶ֣סֶד נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ אַהֲבַ֖ת כְּלוּלֹתָ֑יִךְ לֶכְתֵּ֤ךְ אַחֲרַי֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א זְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lōḵ wə·qā·rā·ṯā ḇə·’ā·zə·nê yə·rū·šā·lim lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh zā·ḵar·tî lāḵ ḥe·seḏ nə·‘ū·ra·yiḵ ’a·hă·ḇaṯ kə·lū·lō·ṯā·yiḵ leḵ·têḵ ’a·ḥă·ray bam·miḏ·bār bə·’e·reṣ lō zə·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem that this is what . . . the LORD says I remember the devotion of your youth your love as a bride how you followed Me . . . in the wilderness in a land not sown
verses.literalPt: Vai, e clama aos ouvidos de Jerusalém, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Lembro-me de ti, da piedade da tua mocidade, e do amor do teu noivado, quando me seguias no deserto, numa terra que não se semeava.

verses.original: קֹ֤דֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַיהוָ֔ה רֵאשִׁ֖ית תְּבוּאָתֹ֑ה כָּל־ אֹכְלָ֣יו יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ רָעָ֛ה תָּבֹ֥א אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: qō·ḏeš yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh rê·šîṯ tə·ḇū·ʾå̄·ṯōh kāl- ’ō·ḵə·lāw ye’·šā·mū rā·‘āh tā·ḇō ’ă·lê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Israel was holy to the LORD the firstfruits of His harvest All who devoured her were found guilty disaster came upon them declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então Israel era santidade para o SENHOR, e as primícias da sua novidade; todos os que o devoravam eram tidos por culpados; o mal vinha sobre eles, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְכָֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḵāl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Hear the word of the LORD O house of Jacob and all you families of the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, ó casa de Jacó, e todas as famílias da casa de Israel;

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה מַה־ מָּצְא֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֥ם בִּי֙ עָ֔וֶל כִּ֥י רָחֲק֖וּ מֵעָלָ֑י וַיֵּֽלְכ֛וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַהֶ֖בֶל וַיֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh mah- mā·ṣə·’ū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bî ‘ā·wel kî rā·ḥă·qū mê·‘ā·lāy way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê ha·he·ḇel way·yeh·bā·lū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me They followed . . . worthless idols and became worthless themselves
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Que injustiça acharam vossos pais em mim, para se afastarem de mim, indo após a vaidade, e tornando-se levianos?

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אָמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַמַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַמּוֹלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּאֶ֨רֶץ עֲרָבָ֤ה וְשׁוּחָה֙ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ צִיָּ֣ה וְצַלְמָ֔וֶת בְּאֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא־ עָ֤בַר בָּהּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ יָשַׁ֥ב אָדָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ā·mə·rū ’ay·yêh Yah·weh ham·ma·‘ă·leh ’ō·ṯā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ham·mō·w·lîḵ ’ō·ṯā·nū bam·miḏ·bār bə·’e·reṣ ‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·šū·ḥāh bə·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ bə·’e·reṣ lō- ‘ā·ḇar bāh ’îš wə·lō- yā·šaḇ ’ā·ḏām šām
verses.literal: They did not ask Where is the LORD who brought us up from the land of Egypt who led us through the wilderness through a land of deserts and pits a land of drought and darkness a land where no one travels and no one lives
verses.literalPt: E não disseram: Onde está o SENHOR, que nos fez subir da terra do Egito, que nos guiou através do deserto, por uma terra árida, e de covas, por uma terra de sequidão e sombra de morte, por uma terra pela qual ninguém transitava, e na qual não morava homem algum?

verses.original: וָאָבִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל לֶאֱכֹ֥ל פִּרְיָ֖הּ וְטוּבָ֑הּ וַתָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַתְּטַמְּא֣וּ אֶת־ אַרְצִ֔י וְנַחֲלָתִ֥י שַׂמְתֶּ֖ם לְתוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’e·reṣ hak·kar·mel le·’ĕ·ḵōl pir·yāh wə·ṭū·ḇāh wat·tā·ḇō·’ū wat·tə·ṭam·mə·’ū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣî wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯî śam·tem lə·ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh
verses.literal: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and bounty but you came and defiled My land and made My inheritance detestable
verses.literalPt: E eu vos introduzi numa terra fértil, para comerdes o seu fruto e o seu bem; mas quando nela entrastes contaminastes a minha terra, e da minha herança fizestes uma abominação.

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים לֹ֤א אָֽמְרוּ֙ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה וְתֹפְשֵׂ֤י הַתּוֹרָה֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּנִי וְהָרֹעִ֖ים פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑י וְהַנְּבִיאִים֙ נִבְּא֣וּ בַבַּ֔עַל וְאַחֲרֵ֥י לֹֽא־ יוֹעִ֖לוּ הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm lō ’ā·mə·rū ’ay·yêh Yah·weh wə·ṯō·p̄ə·śê hat·tō·w·rāh lō yə·ḏā·‘ū·nî wə·hā·rō·‘îm pā·šə·‘ū ḇî wə·han·nə·ḇî·’îm nib·bə·’ū ḇab·ba·‘al wə·’a·ḥă·rê lō- yō·w·‘i·lū hā·lā·ḵū
verses.literal: The priests did not ask Where is the LORD The experts in the law no longer knew Me and the leaders rebelled against Me The prophets prophesied by Baal and followed . . . useless idols
verses.literalPt: Os sacerdotes não disseram: Onde está o SENHOR? E os que tratavam da lei não me conheciam, e os pastores prevaricavam contra mim, e os profetas profetizavam por Baal, e andaram após o que é de nenhum proveito.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן עֹ֛ד אָרִ֥יב אִתְּכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י בְנֵיכֶ֖ם אָרִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ‘ōḏ ’ā·rîḇ ’it·tə·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bə·nê ḇə·nê·ḵem ’ā·rîḇ
verses.literal: Therefore I will contend with you again declares the LORD and I will bring a case against your children’s children
verses.literalPt: Portanto ainda contenderei convosco, diz o SENHOR; e até com os filhos de vossos filhos contenderei.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִבְר֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י כִתִּיִּים֙ וּרְא֔וּ וְקֵדָ֛ר שִׁלְח֥וּ וְהִֽתְבּוֹנְנ֖וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּרְא֕וּ הֵ֥ן הָיְתָ֖ה כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘iḇ·rū ’î·yê ḵit·tî·yîm ū·rə·’ū wə·qê·ḏār šil·ḥū wə·hiṯ·bō·wn·nū mə·’ōḏ ū·rə·’ū hên hā·yə·ṯāh kā·zōṯ
verses.literal: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and take a look send to Kedar and consider carefully see if there has ever been anything like this
verses.literalPt: Pois, passai às ilhas de Quitim, e vede; e enviai a Quedar, e atentai bem, e vede se jamais sucedeu coisa semelhante.

verses.original: הַהֵימִ֥יר גּוֹי֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה לֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַמִּ֛י הֵמִ֥יר כְּבוֹד֖וֹ בְּל֥וֹא יוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hê·mîr gō·w ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hêm·māh lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·‘am·mî hê·mîr kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw bə·lō·w yō·w·‘îl
verses.literal: Has a nation ever changed its gods Yet they are not gods at all But My people have exchanged their Glory for useless idols
verses.literalPt: Houve alguma nação que trocasse os seus deuses, ainda que não fossem deuses? Todavia o meu povo trocou a sua glória por aquilo que é de nenhum proveito.

verses.original: שֹׁ֥מּוּ שָׁמַ֖יִם עַל־ זֹ֑את וְשַׂעֲר֛וּ חָרְב֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šōm·mū šā·ma·yim ‘al- zōṯ wə·śa·‘ă·rū ḥā·rə·ḇū mə·’ōḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Be stunned by this O heavens be shocked and utterly appalled declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Espantai-vos disto, ó céus, e horrorizai-vos! Ficai verdadeiramente desolados, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שְׁתַּ֥יִם רָע֖וֹת עָשָׂ֣ה עַמִּ֑י אֹתִ֨י עָזְב֜וּ מְק֣וֹר׀ מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֗ים לַחְצֹ֤ב לָהֶם֙ בֹּאר֔וֹת בֹּארֹת֙ נִשְׁבָּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָכִ֖לוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šə·ta·yim rā·‘ō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh ‘am·mî ’ō·ṯî ‘ā·zə·ḇū mə·qō·wr ma·yim ḥay·yîm laḥ·ṣōḇ lā·hem bō·rō·wṯ bō·rōṯ niš·bā·rîm ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḵi·lū ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: For My people have committed two evils They have forsaken Me the fountain of living water and they have dug their own cisterns broken cisterns that cannot hold water
verses.literalPt: Porque o meu povo fez duas maldades: a mim me deixaram, o manancial de águas vivas, e cavaram cisternas, cisternas rotas, que não retêm águas.

verses.original: הַעֶ֙בֶד֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־ יְלִ֥יד בַּ֖יִת ה֑וּא מַדּ֖וּעַ הָיָ֥ה לָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘e·ḇeḏ yiś·rā·’êl ’im- yə·lîḏ ba·yiṯ hū mad·dū·a‘ hā·yāh lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: Is Israel . . . a slave Was he born into slavery . . . Why then has he become prey
verses.literalPt: Acaso é Israel um servo? É ele um escravo nascido em casa? Porque, pois, veio a ser presa?

verses.original: עָלָיו֙ יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ כְפִרִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑ם וַיָּשִׁ֤יתוּ אַרְצוֹ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה עָרָ֥יו נִצְּתָה מִבְּלִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāw yiš·’ă·ḡū ḵə·p̄i·rîm nā·ṯə·nū qō·w·lām way·yā·šî·ṯū ’ar·ṣōw lə·šam·māh ‘ā·rāw niṣ·ṣə·ṯå̄h mib·bə·lî yō·šêḇ
verses.literal: The young lions have roared at him they have sounded their voices They have laid waste his land his cities lie in ruins without inhabitant
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de leão rugiram sobre ele, levantaram a sua voz; e fizeram da sua terra uma desolação; as suas cidades se queimaram, e ninguém habita nelas.

verses.original: גַּם־ בְּנֵי־ נֹ֖ף וְתַחְפְּנֵס יִרְע֖וּךְ קָדְקֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bə·nê- nōp̄ wə·ṯaḥ·pə·nēs yir·‘ūḵ qā·ḏə·qōḏ
verses.literal: The men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head
verses.literalPt: Até os filhos de Nofe e de Tafnes te quebraram o alto da cabeça.

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־ זֹ֖את תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ עָזְבֵךְ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִךְ בְּעֵ֖ת מוֹלִיכֵ֥ךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- zōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh- lāḵ ‘ā·zə·ḇêḵ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·ha·yiḵ bə·‘êṯ mō·w·lî·ḵêḵ bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Have you not brought this on yourself by forsaking the LORD your God when He led you in the way
verses.literalPt: Porventura não fizeste isto a ti mesmo, deixando o SENHOR teu Deus, no tempo em que ele te guiava pelo caminho?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה מַה־ לָּךְ֙ לְדֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֣י שִׁח֑וֹר וּמַה־ לָּךְ֙ לְדֶ֣רֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לִשְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֥י נָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh mah- lāḵ lə·ḏe·reḵ miṣ·ra·yim liš·tō·wṯ mê ši·ḥō·wr ū·mah- lāḵ lə·ḏe·reḵ ’aš·šūr liš·tō·wṯ mê nā·hār
verses.literal: Now what will you gain on your way to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile What will you gain on your way to Assyria to drink the waters of the Euphrates
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, que te importa a ti o caminho do Egito, para beberes as águas de Sior? E que te importa a ti o caminho da Assíria, para beberes as águas do rio?

verses.original: תְּיַסְּרֵ֣ךְ רָעָתֵ֗ךְ וּמְשֻֽׁבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ תּוֹכִחֻ֔ךְ וּדְעִ֤י וּרְאִי֙ כִּי־ רַ֣ע וָמָ֔ר עָזְבֵ֖ךְ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ וְלֹ֤א פַחְדָּתִי֙ אֵלַ֔יִךְ נְאֻם־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: tə·yas·sə·rêḵ rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ ū·mə·šu·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ tō·w·ḵi·ḥuḵ ū·ḏə·‘î ū·rə·’î kî- ra‘ wā·mār ‘ā·zə·ḇêḵ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ wə·lō p̄aḥ·dā·ṯî ’ê·la·yiḵ nə·’um- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Your own evil will discipline you your own apostasies will reprimand you Consider and realize how evil and bitter it is for you to forsake the LORD your God and to have no fear of Me declares the Lord GOD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: A tua malícia te castigará, e as tuas apostasias te repreenderão; sabe, pois, e vê, que mal e quão amargo é deixares ao SENHOR teu Deus, e não teres em ti o meu temor, diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵעוֹלָ֞ם שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי עֻלֵּ֗ךְ נִתַּ֙קְתִּי֙ מוֹסְרֹתַ֔יִךְ וַתֹּאמְרִ֖י לֹ֣א אֶעֱבֹד כִּ֣י עַֽל־ כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֞ה גְּבֹהָ֗ה וְתַ֙חַת֙ כָּל־ עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן אַ֖תְּ צֹעָ֥ה זֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî mê·‘ō·w·lām šā·ḇar·tî ‘ul·lêḵ nit·taq·tî mō·ws·rō·ṯa·yiḵ wat·tō·mə·rî lō ʾɛ·ʿɛ̆·ḇōḏ kî ‘al- kāl- giḇ·‘āh gə·ḇō·hāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kāl- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān ’at ṣō·‘āh zō·nāh
verses.literal: For long ago you broke your yoke and tore off your chains saying I will not serve Indeed on every high hill and under every green tree you lay down as a prostitute
verses.literalPt: Quando eu já há muito quebrava o teu jugo, e rompia as tuas ataduras, dizias tu: Nunca mais transgredirei; contudo em todo o outeiro alto e debaixo de toda a árvore verde te andas encurvando e prostituindo-te.

verses.original: וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נְטַעְתִּ֣יךְ שֹׂרֵ֔ק כֻּלֹּ֖ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵיךְ֙ נֶהְפַּ֣כְתְּ לִ֔י סוּרֵ֖י הַגֶּ֥פֶן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî nə·ṭa‘·tîḵ śō·rêq kul·lōh ze·ra‘ ’ĕ·meṯ wə·’êḵ neh·paḵt lî sū·rê hag·ge·p̄en nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: I had planted you like a choice vine from the very best seed How could you turn yourself before Me into a rotten wild vine
verses.literalPt: Eu mesmo te plantei como vide excelente, uma semente inteiramente fiel; como, pois, te tornaste para mim uma planta degenerada como vide estranha?

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ תְּכַבְּסִי֙ בַּנֶּ֔תֶר וְתַרְבִּי־ לָ֖ךְ בֹּרִ֑ית נִכְתָּ֤ם עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ לְפָנַ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- tə·ḵab·bə·sî ban·ne·ṯer wə·ṯar·bî- lāḵ bō·rîṯ niḵ·tām ‘ă·wō·nêḵ lə·p̄ā·nay nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Although . . . you wash with lye and use an abundance of soap the stain of your guilt is still before Me declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Por isso, ainda que te laves com salitre, e amontoes sabão, a tua iniqüidade está gravada diante de mim, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תֹּאמְרִ֞י לֹ֣א נִטְמֵ֗אתִי אַחֲרֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ לֹ֣א הָלַ֔כְתִּי רְאִ֤י דַרְכֵּךְ֙ בַּגַּ֔יְא דְּעִ֖י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑ית בִּכְרָ֥ה קַלָּ֖ה מְשָׂרֶ֥כֶת דְּרָכֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ tō·mə·rî lō niṭ·mê·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê hab·bə·‘ā·lîm lō hā·laḵ·tî rə·’î ḏar·kêḵ bag·gay də·‘î meh ‘ā·śîṯ biḵ·rāh qal·lāh mə·śā·re·ḵeṯ də·rā·ḵe·hā
verses.literal: How can you say I am not defiled I have not run after the Baals Look at your behavior in the valley acknowledge what you have done You are a swift young she-camel galloping here and there . . .
verses.literalPt: Como dizes logo: Não estou contaminada nem andei após os baalins? Vê o teu caminho no vale, conhece o que fizeste; dromedária ligeira és, que anda torcendo os seus caminhos.

verses.original: פֶּ֣רֶה׀ לִמֻּ֣ד מִדְבָּ֗ר בְּאַוַּ֤ת נַפְשׁוֹ שָׁאֲפָ֣ה ר֔וּחַ תַּאֲנָתָ֖הּ מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נָּה כָּל־ מְבַקְשֶׁ֙יהָ֙ לֹ֣א יִיעָ֔פוּ בְּחָדְשָׁ֖הּ יִמְצָאֽוּנְהָ׃
verses.transliteration: pe·reh lim·muḏ miḏ·bār bə·’aw·waṯ nap̄·šō šā·’ă·p̄āh rū·aḥ ta·’ă·nā·ṯāh mî yə·šî·ḇen·nāh kāl- mə·ḇaq·še·hā lō yî·‘ā·p̄ū bə·ḥā·ḏə·šāh yim·ṣā·’ū·nə·hā
verses.literal: a wild donkey at home in the wilderness sniffing the wind in the heat of her desire Who can restrain her passion All who seek her need not weary themselves in mating season they will find her
verses.literalPt: Jumenta montês, acostumada ao deserto, que, conforme o desejo da sua alma, sorve o vento, quem a deteria no seu cio? Todos os que a buscarem não se cansarão; no mês dela a acharão.

verses.original: מִנְעִ֤י רַגְלֵךְ֙ מִיָּחֵ֔ף וְגוֹרְנֵךְ מִצִּמְאָ֑ה וַתֹּאמְרִ֣י נוֹאָ֔שׁ ל֕וֹא כִּֽי־ אָהַ֥בְתִּי זָרִ֖ים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֥ם אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: min·‘î raḡ·lêḵ mî·yā·ḥêp̄ wə·ḡō·rə·nēḵ miṣ·ṣim·’āh wat·tō·mə·rî nō·w·’āš lō·w kî- ’ā·haḇ·tî zā·rîm wə·’a·ḥă·rê·hem ’ê·lêḵ
verses.literal: You should have kept your feet from going bare and your throat from being thirsty But you said It is hopeless . . . For I love foreign gods and I must go after them
verses.literalPt: Evita que o teu pé ande descalço, e a tua garganta tenha sede. Mas tu dizes: Não há esperança; porque amo os estranhos, após eles andarei.

verses.original: כְּבֹ֤שֶׁת גַּנָּב֙ כִּ֣י יִמָּצֵ֔א כֵּ֥ן הֹבִ֖ישׁוּ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵיהֶ֔ם וְכֹהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִיאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇō·šeṯ gan·nāḇ kî yim·mā·ṣê kên hō·ḇî·šū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh mal·ḵê·hem śā·rê·hem wə·ḵō·hă·nê·hem ū·nə·ḇî·’ê·hem
verses.literal: As the thief is ashamed when he is caught so the house of Israel is disgraced They their kings their officials their priests and their prophets
verses.literalPt: Como fica confundido o ladrão quando o apanham, assim se confundem os da casa de Israel; eles, os seus reis, os seus príncipes, e os seus sacerdotes, e os seus profetas,

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֨ים לָעֵ֜ץ אָ֣בִי אַ֗תָּה וְלָאֶ֙בֶן֙ אַ֣תְּ יְלִדְתִּנִי כִּֽי־ פָנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛י עֹ֖רֶף וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וּבְעֵ֤ת רָֽעָתָם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ ק֖וּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mə·rîm lā·‘êṣ ’ā·ḇî ’at·tāh wə·lā·’e·ḇen ’at yə·liḏ·ti·nī kî- p̄ā·nū ’ê·lay ‘ō·rep̄ wə·lō p̄ā·nîm ū·ḇə·‘êṯ rā·‘ā·ṯām yō·mə·rū qū·māh wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: say to a tree You are my father and to a stone You gave me birth They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces Yet in the time of trouble they say Rise up and save us
verses.literalPt: Que dizem ao pau: Tu és meu pai; e à pedra: Tu me geraste; porque me viraram as costas, e não o rosto; mas no tempo da sua angústia dirão: Levanta-te, e livra-nos.

verses.original: וְאַיֵּ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔ךְ יָק֕וּמוּ אִם־ יוֹשִׁיע֖וּךָ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר עָרֶ֔יךָ הָי֥וּ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יְהוּדָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ay·yêh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā lāḵ yā·qū·mū ’im- yō·wō·šî·‘ū·ḵā bə·‘êṯ rā·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā kî mis·par ‘ā·re·ḵā hā·yū ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: But where are the gods you made for yourselves Let them rise up in your time of trouble and save you if they can for your gods are as numerous as your cities O Judah
verses.literalPt: Onde, pois, estão os teus deuses, que fizeste para ti? Que se levantem, se te podem livrar no tempo da tua angústia; porque os teus deuses, ó Judá, são tão numerosos como as tuas cidades.

verses.original: לָ֥מָּה תָרִ֖יבוּ אֵלָ֑י כֻּלְּכֶ֛ם פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯā·rî·ḇū ’ê·lāy kul·lə·ḵem pə·ša‘·tem bî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Why do you bring a case against Me You have all rebelled against Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Por que contendeis comigo? Todos vós transgredistes contra mim, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: לַשָּׁוְא֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם מוּסָ֖ר לֹ֣א לָקָ֑חוּ אָכְלָ֧ה חַרְבְּכֶ֛ם נְבִֽיאֵיכֶ֖ם כְּאַרְיֵ֥ה מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: laš·šāw hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem mū·sār lō lā·qā·ḥū ’ā·ḵə·lāh ḥar·bə·ḵem nə·ḇî·’ê·ḵem kə·’ar·yêh maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: I have struck your sons in vain they accepted no discipline Your own sword has devoured your prophets like a voracious lion
verses.literalPt: Em vão castiguei os vossos filhos; eles não aceitaram a correção; a vossa espada devorou os vossos profetas como um leão destruidor.

verses.original: הַדּ֗וֹר אַתֶּם֙ רְא֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה הֲמִדְבָּ֤ר הָיִ֙יתִי֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֛ם אֶ֥רֶץ מַאְפֵּ֖לְיָ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ אָמְר֤וּ עַמִּי֙ רַ֔דְנוּ לֽוֹא־ נָב֥וֹא ע֖וֹד אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: had·dō·wr ’at·tem rə·’ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hă·miḏ·bār hā·yî·ṯî lə·yiś·rā·’êl ’im ’e·reṣ ma’·pê·lə·yāh mad·dū·a‘ ’ā·mə·rū ‘am·mî raḏ·nū lō·w- nā·ḇō·w ‘ō·wḏ ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: You people of this generation consider the word of the LORD Have I been a wilderness to Israel or a land of dense darkness Why do My people say We are free to roam we will come to You no more
verses.literalPt: Oh geração! Considerai vós a palavra do SENHOR: Porventura tenho eu sido para Israel um deserto? Ou uma terra da mais espessa escuridão? Por que, pois, diz o meu povo: Temos determinado; não viremos mais a ti?

verses.original: הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח בְּתוּלָה֙ עֶדְיָ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה קִשֻּׁרֶ֑יהָ וְעַמִּ֣י שְׁכֵח֔וּנִי יָמִ֖ים אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯiš·kaḥ bə·ṯū·lāh ‘eḏ·yāh kal·lāh qiš·šu·re·hā wə·‘am·mî šə·ḵê·ḥū·nî yā·mîm ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number
verses.literalPt: Porventura esquece-se a virgem dos seus enfeites, ou a noiva dos seus adornos? Todavia o meu povo se esqueceu de mim por inumeráveis dias.

verses.original: מַה־ תֵּיטִ֥בִי דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה לָכֵן֙ גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הָרָע֔וֹת לִמַּדְתִּי אֶת־ דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- tê·ṭi·ḇî dar·kêḵ lə·ḇaq·qêš ’a·hă·ḇāh lā·ḵên gam ’eṯ- hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ lim·maḏ·tī ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵā·yiḵ
verses.literal: How skillfully . . . you pursue love . . . Even the most immoral of women could learn from your ways
verses.literalPt: Por que ornamentas o teu caminho, para buscares o amor? Pois até às malignas ensinaste os teus caminhos.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בִּכְנָפַ֙יִךְ֙ נִמְצְא֔וּ דַּ֛ם נַפְשׁ֥וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים נְקִיִּ֑ים לֹֽא־ בַמַּחְתֶּ֥רֶת מְצָאתִ֖ים כִּ֥י עַל־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: gam biḵ·nā·p̄a·yiḵ nim·ṣə·’ū dam nap̄·šō·wṯ ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm nə·qî·yîm lō- ḇam·maḥ·te·reṯ mə·ṣā·ṯîm kî ‘al- kāl- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Moreover your skirts are stained with the blood . . . of the innocent poor though you did not find them breaking in But in spite of all these things
verses.literalPt: Até nas orlas dos teus vestidos se achou o sangue das almas dos inocentes e necessitados; não cavei para achar, pois se vê em todas estas coisas.

verses.original: וַתֹּֽאמְרִי֙ כִּ֣י נִקֵּ֔יתִי אַ֛ךְ שָׁ֥ב אַפּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נִּי הִנְנִי֙ נִשְׁפָּ֣ט אוֹתָ֔ךְ עַל־ אָמְרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א חָטָֽאתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mə·rî kî niq·qê·ṯî ’aḵ šāḇ ’ap·pōw mim·men·nî hin·nî niš·pāṭ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ‘al- ’ā·mə·rêḵ lō ḥā·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: you say . . . I am innocent Surely His anger will turn from me Behold I will judge you because you say I have not sinned
verses.literalPt: E ainda dizes: Eu estou inocente; certamente a sua ira se desviou de mim. Eis que entrarei em juízo contigo, porquanto dizes: Não pequei.

verses.original: מַה־ תֵּזְלִ֥י מְאֹ֖ד לְשַׁנּ֣וֹת אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּ֑ךְ גַּ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ תֵּב֔וֹשִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בֹּ֖שְׁתְּ מֵאַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: mah- tê·zə·lî mə·’ōḏ lə·šan·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- dar·kêḵ gam mim·miṣ·ra·yim tê·ḇō·wō·šî ka·’ă·šer- bō·šət mê·’aš·šūr
verses.literal: How impulsive you are constantly changing your ways . . . You will be disappointed by Egypt just as you were by Assyria
verses.literalPt: Por que te desvias tanto, mudando o teu caminho? Também do Egito serás envergonhada, como foste envergonhada da Assíria.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מֵאֵ֥ת זֶה֙ תֵּֽצְאִ֔י וְיָדַ֖יִךְ עַל־ רֹאשֵׁ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ מָאַ֤ס יְהֹוָה֙ בְּמִבְטַחַ֔יִךְ וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחִי לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam mê·’êṯ zeh tê·ṣə·’î wə·yā·ḏa·yiḵ ‘al- rō·šêḵ kî- mā·’as Yah·weh bə·miḇ·ṭa·ḥa·yiḵ wə·lō ṯaṣ·lî·ḥî lā·hem
verses.literal: Moreover . . . you will leave that place with your hands on your head for the LORD has rejected those you trust you will not prosper by their help
verses.literalPt: Também daquele sairás com as mãos sobre a tua cabeça; porque o SENHOR rejeitou a tua confiança, e não prosperarás com eles.
